title: test
description: Result of `stride test <activity_id> <kind> [--apply-zones]`: the session marked as a threshold test and the threshold it yields (ADR 0020).

signal.description: Which threshold the test sets: power (the family's FTP), pace (the sport type's threshold speed) or hr (a lactate-threshold heart rate, which changes scoring only through --apply-zones).

in_force_until.description: The last date the test can set its population's threshold: the session's date plus the in-force span.

zones_applied.description: True when --apply-zones wrote zone ceilings from this test; `zones` is all zeros and `zone_sports` empty when false.

zone_sports.description: The sport types whose per-sport zone keys were written: every type in the test's family.
